help.output:
Local control console for AI agent setup.

Run without a command to see an overview of your agents, how their MCP servers line up, and what to fix first. Use `gandalf tui` for the interactive console.

Usage:
  gandalf [flags]
  gandalf [command]

Available Commands:
  apply       Apply team agent manifest (gandalf.toml) to local agent environments.
  boost       Selectively inject agent skill profiles via portable relative symlinks.
  bundle      Export, import, inspect, and verify .gandalf bundle archives
  check       Check for drift between team agent manifest and local setup.
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  diff        Show semantic and raw-source changes between two snapshots
  doctor      Check local readiness for agent setup portability
  export      Export local agent config to gandalf.toml (manifest only).
  help        Help about any command
  init        Initialize a team agent manifest (gandalf.toml) in current repository.
  overview    Summarize your agents, MCP servers across agents, and what to fix first
  report      Generate a markdown report of agent state and findings
  restore     Generate a restore plan (dry-run) or apply a snapshot (experimental)
  scan        Scan project for agent configuration and emit evidence inventory
  snapshot    Create, list, and show snapshots
  timeline    List and inspect local timeline entries
  tui         Launch the interactive global setup console

Flags:
      --agent string     Filter by agent
  -h, --help             help for gandalf
      --home string      Home directory (defaults to $HOME)
      --json             Emit JSON output
  -p, --project string   Project directory to scan (default ".")
      --scope string     Filter by evidence scope
      --store string     Gandalf store directory (defaults to ~/.gandalf or $GANDALF_STORE)

Use "gandalf [command] --help" for more information about a command.
